title: Atomically-precise colloidal nanoparticles of cerium dioxide

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Benzoate- and pyridine-stabilized Ce24 ceria nanocluster

synthesis.procedure: Ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate and benzoic acid were reacted in a 1:2 molar ratio in pyridine at room temperature. The golden-yellow solution was stirred for 30 min, diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile, and left undisturbed for one week. Yellow square plates were filtered, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile; yellow square plates collected by filtration, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: An EPR spectrum of a microcrystalline sample supports the presence of Ce(III); the structure contains two Ce(III) ions.

source_locations.location: Results, introductory nanocluster formulas and Nanocluster structures; Fig. 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A 24-Ce fluorite-type oxide/hydroxide core with benzoate and pyridine surface ligands; its Ce core is approximately 0.75 × 1.10 × 1.10 nm and displays (100) and (111) facets.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Propionate- and pyridine-stabilized Ce38 ceria nanocluster

synthesis.procedure: Ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, the corresponding carboxylic acid (propionic acid), and ammonium iodide were reacted in a 1:4:1 molar ratio in pyridine/water (10:1 v/v) at room temperature. The golden-yellow solution was stirred for 30 min, diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile, and left undisturbed for four weeks. Yellow square plates were filtered, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pyridine/water reaction medium (10:1 v/v) diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile; yellow square plates collected by filtration, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.

source_locations.location: Results, introductory nanocluster formulas and Nanocluster structures; Fig. 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A roughly spherical 38-Ce fluorite-type oxide/hydroxide core, approximately 1.12 × 1.12 × 1.12 nm, with propionate and pyridine surface ligands and (100) and (111) facets. The two independent clusters designated 2a and 2b have the same formulation.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Acetate/acetic-acid- and pyridine-stabilized Ce40 ceria nanocluster

synthesis.procedure: Ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, the corresponding carboxylic acid (acetic acid), and ammonium iodide were reacted in a 1:4:1 molar ratio in pyridine/water (10:1 v/v) at room temperature. The golden-yellow solution was stirred for 30 min, diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile, and left undisturbed for four weeks. Yellow rods of crystalline 3, containing independent clusters 3a and 3b, were filtered, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pyridine/water reaction medium (10:1 v/v) diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile; yellow rods collected by filtration, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: An EPR spectrum of a microcrystalline sample of 3, which contains both 3a and 3b, supports Ce(III). The measurement was not resolved separately for 3a.

measurements.name: Ce(III) EPR spectrum of shared 3 sample
measurements.conditions: Microcrystalline powder at 5 K; sample contains 3a and 3b

source_locations.location: Results, introductory nanocluster formulas, Nanocluster structures and Surface features; Figs. 1 and 3
Supplied CCDC catalog row for the crystal containing 3a and 3b

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: One of two independently formulated Ce40 clusters in the asymmetric unit of crystalline 3. Its fluorite-type core is approximately 1.13 × 1.13 × 1.61 nm and has (100), (111), and (110) facets. Chelating carboxylates act as weakly interacting lids over some surface Ce4 squares.

synthesis.procedure: Ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, the corresponding carboxylic acid (acetic acid), and ammonium iodide were reacted in a 1:4:1 molar ratio in pyridine/water (10:1 v/v) at room temperature. The golden-yellow solution was stirred for 30 min, diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile, and left undisturbed for four weeks. Yellow rods of crystalline 3, containing independent clusters 3a and 3b, were filtered, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pyridine/water reaction medium (10:1 v/v) diluted with two volumes of acetonitrile; yellow rods collected by filtration, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: An EPR spectrum of a microcrystalline sample of 3, which contains both 3a and 3b, supports Ce(III). The measurement was not resolved separately for 3b.

measurements.conditions: Microcrystalline powder at 5 K; sample contains 3a and 3b

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The second independently formulated Ce40 cluster in the asymmetric unit of crystalline 3. It shares the fluorite-type core and facets of 3a, but acetonitrile ligands replace two of 3a's protonated acetate ligands; bound acetonitrile acts as a weakly interacting lid over a surface Ce4 square.
